simple.meaning: פְּרוּדָא (Pᵉrûwdâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Peruda or Perida , one of 'Solomon's servants'.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פְּרוּדָא (H6514) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:55, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פְּרוּדָא (H6514) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פְּרוּדָא (H6514) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פְּרוּדָא (Pᵉrûwdâʼ) / H6514 is traced through Ezra 2:55, Nehemiah 7:57 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
